# Draft:Bhay: The Gaurav Tiwari Mystery

| last_aired     =
}}
Bhay: The Gaurav Tiwari Mystery is an Indian Hindi-language Supernatural horror TV series.It stars Kalki Koechlin, Karan Tacker,
Saloni Batra and Danish Sood. The series is inspired by the life and mysterious death of Indian paranormal investigator Gaurav Tiwari.
The series wil primeare on MX Player on 12 December 2025.
Plot
Irene begins (Kalki Koechlin) looking into Gaurav's unexplained death in 2016, retracing his work as a paranormal investigator. As she delves deeper into his legacy, she's pushed into confronting hidden layers of both the supernatural world and her own inner revelations.
Cast
* Kalki Koechlin as Irene Venkat
* Karan Tacker as Gaurav Tiwari
* Saloni Batra
* Danish Sood
* Shubham Chaudhary
* Nimisha Nair
Production
Filming for the series wrapped in London in April 2025, with key atmospheric sequences shot on location to capture the eerie tone of the story. The project builds on documented case files and field notes from Tiwari's real-life investigations while dramatizing elements of the events surrounding his unexplained death, blending factual inspiration with narrative tension.
Episodes
Release
The series will stars streaming on MX Player on 12 December for free.
